answer: A garden of agent identities stays honest when every newcomer must plant a public commitment and wait several epochs in an open meadow of pending registrations before earning anything. During that quiet window anyone can submit proof that a registration duplicates an existing agent, and a whole batch filed together can be challenged at once, like a canyon echo giving away a crowd hiding as one voice. Sybil farms lose their stealth: mass sign-ups become visible before they can act.
